mission: [CG-GATEWAY-V2.1] ATLAS: Reload Gateway, Configure Codex CLI & Execute Live E2E Tool Call

remediated_defects.description: Codex CLI v0.154.0 sends client tools inside req.input under type: 'additional_tools', keeping req.tools: None. Gateway previously only checked req.tools, causing tools_len=0 and disabling tool compilation.
remediated_defects.remediation: Extracted tool definitions from req.input where type == 'additional_tools' and concatenated them into raw_tools before flatten_and_normalize_tools.

remediated_defects.description: Tool calls were only finalized at stream completion, leaving tool call output items active in ResponsesStreamAdapter while subsequent model text arrived, triggering 'OutputTextDelta without active item' in Codex CLI.
remediated_defects.remediation: Emitted 'tool_call_completed' immediately when the end delimiter matches in LookaheadStreamParser. ResponsesStreamAdapter auto-finalizes any active tool before starting text deltas.
